selected_script.angle: Eliminating kitchen cleaning chaos with a heavy-duty, one-handed tear paper towel holder featuring a hidden integrated spray bottle.
selected_script.hook: Tired of your paper towel holder tipping over and rolling away every time you have a spill?

script_record.title: Ultrean Stand with Spray Bottle - Pain & Conflict Fast Cut

video_001_part_01.narrative: A standard flimsy paper towel holder tips over when pulled one-handed, leaving a messy roll. Instantly, we switch to the Ultrean Matte Black Stand, standing firm with its weighted base. A hand pushes the top button, removing the hidden spray bottle.

video_001_part_02.narrative: A hand sprays the counter with the integrated bottle, wipes it clean, and pops the bottle back into the solid black rod. A single sheet of paper towel is smoothly torn away using the tension arm. CTA appears: A simple upgrade for everyday kitchen use.

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, realistic handheld phone-shot. 0-3s pain conflict: a standard paper towel holder tips over and spills when pulled one-handed. 3-6s quick solution: introduce the Ultrean paper towel holder, showing its heavy matte black base staying firmly in place as a hand tears a sheet. 6-10s fast-cut scene 1: close-up of a hand pressing the top lock button on the solid black rod and pulling out the hidden clear spray bottle. Match exact product colors: matte black exterior, solid rod, circular base.

Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video, realistic handheld phone-shot. 0-4s fast-cut scene 2: hand spraying cleaning solution onto a kitchen counter from the transparent 4oz bottle. 4-8s fast-cut scene 3: hand locks the spray bottle back into the solid black center rod, then effortlessly tears a paper towel using the angled tension arm. 8-10s CTA: light text overlay 'A simple upgrade for everyday kitchen use.' Maintain identical product identity, color, and pacing as part 1.
